By virtue of the authority vested in me  
by section 5 of title 2 of the Canal Zone  
Code, approved June 19, 1934, and as  
President of the United States, Executive 
Order No. 2987 of November 4,1918, plac­
ing certain land and water areas in  
Gatun Lake, Canal Zone, under the con­
trol of the Secretary of the Navy for use  
as a Naval Air Station, is hereby revoked  
and such land returned to the control and  
jurisdiction of the Governor of The  
Panama Canal.

text_pointers.first_1500_characters:
CANAL ZONE

By virtue of the authority vested in me by section 5 of title 2 of the Canal Zone Code, approved June 19, 1934, and as President of the United States, Executive Order No. 2987 of November 4, 1918, placing certain land and water areas in Gatun Lake, Canal Zone, under the control of the Secretary of the Navy for use as a Naval Air Station, is hereby revoked and such land returned to the control and jurisdiction of the Governor of The Panama Canal.

FRANKLIN D ROOSEVELT

The White House,

April 25, 1942.
